articles.description: Victor Osimhen, Maduka Okoye and Kelechi Iheanacho were missing as Nigeria coach Eric Chelle named his 24-man squad for the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifying double-header against Tanzania.

articles.headline: Post-match chaos sours Victor Osimhen brace in Galatasaray win over Fenerbahce
articles.description: Victor Osimhen warned of chaos ahead of Monday's Istanbul derby against Fenerbahce, and it duly arrived after the final whistle, as the Nigeria striker scored both goals in Galatasaray's 2-1 victory.

images.name: Galatasaray Fenerbahce [1296x729]
images.caption: Galatasaray and Fenerbahce players clashed after the final whistle, where Gala won the Istanbul derby 2-1.

images.name: Why Harry Kane was the rightful winner of the Ballon d'Or
images.caption: Why Harry Kane was the rightful winner of the Ballon d'Or

articles.headline: Galatasaray's Victor Osimhen bracing for 'chaos' in Istanbul derby against Fenerbahce
articles.description: Victor Osimhen is bracing for chaos in Monday's Istanbul derby against Fenerbahce, with the Nigeria striker hoping for a victory that would move Galatasaray six points clear of their rivals in the Turkish Super Lig title race.

images.name: Galatasaray [1296x729]
images.caption: Galatasaray saw off bitter rivals Fenerbahce to claim another Super Lig title last season.
images.credit: Photo by Salih Zeki Fazlioglu/Anadolu via Getty Images
